evals.prompt: Give me Python code to do a simple chat with gpt-4o-mini using SAP GenAI Hub
evals.expected_output: Agent asks at least one clarifying question (e.g. deployment ID or use case), then generates working Python code using sap-ai-sdk-gen with the native OpenAI proxy, imports from gen_ai_hub (not generative_ai_hub_sdk), and includes the correct install command.
assertions: Agent asks at least one clarifying question before generating code
Generated code imports from gen_ai_hub, not generative_ai_hub or generative_ai_hub_sdk
Install command uses uv add sap-ai-sdk-gen
Generated code uses chat.completions.create() with model_name parameter
Generated code includes a credential setup comment (aicore configure or AICORE_* env vars)
